answer: Neighborhood closure scoring: each agent's reachable vertex set is hashed, and a new identity must land its third-hop neighborhood inside a bounded overlap band with its declared introduction path. An identity whose neighborhood resembles a random rewire more than an organic plume of shared counterparties gets throttled to low-value tasks until its local clustering ratio holds across ten assignment rounds. Faking that costs the attacker a sustained falcon-shaped fan-out of real counterparties per identity, each requiring genuine task throughput to keep the cluster coherent.
